## VIP Number Tiers

### Silver Numbers (Free with most plans)
- Basic repeating or pattern sequences (e.g., ending in XX, XY, XYX)
- Included free with any plan from AED 188/month
- 10,000+ available in catalog

### Gold Numbers (AED 500/month plans)
- Sequential digits (e.g., 1234, 6789), mirror patterns (1221, 3443), or double pairs (1122)
- Included with Gold Plan subscriptions
- 2,000+ premium patterns available
- Also sold as standalone numbers starting at AED 500 one-time

### Platinum Numbers (AED 1,000/month plan)
- Quadruple repeats (e.g., 1111, 7777), ascending sequences (23456), or exact pattern matches
- Included with Platinum Plan
- 200+ ultra-premium numbers
- Standalone pricing AED 2,000-10,000+ for rare patterns

## Network & Technology

### 5G Coverage
- **Included free** in all Freedom postpaid plans
- Active in: Dubai (all districts), Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah
- Partial: Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain
- 5G peak speeds: 1-2 Gbps (device-dependent)
- Compatible devices: iPhone 12+, Samsung Galaxy S21+, Google Pixel 6+, all 5G flagships 2021+

### eSIM Support
- **All postpaid plans support eSIM**
- Instant activation via QR code sent to your email
- Compatible devices (partial list):
  - iPhone: XS, XR, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 series
  - Samsung: Galaxy S20+ through S25, Note 20+, Z Fold/Flip 2+
  - Google Pixel: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 series
  - Most flagship Android phones 2020+

### Data Speeds by Plan
- **Non-Stop Data plans (AED 188-228)**: 3-5 Mbps guaranteed speed, unlimited data
- **Unlimited Data plans (AED 300+)**: HD streaming speeds, unlimited
- **Gold/Platinum plans (AED 500+)**: Maximum device speed (up to 1-2 Gbps on 5G)

## How to Order / Contact

### WhatsApp (Primary)
- Direct: https://wa.me/971569028087
- Business hours: 9 AM - 9 PM UAE time
- Response time: under 30 minutes
- Languages: English, Arabic

### Delivery
- **Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah**: Free same-day delivery (order before 4 PM)
- **Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain**: 1-2 business days
- No shipping fee anywhere in UAE

### Required Documents for New Connection
1. Emirates ID (original + copy)
2. Passport copy
3. Proof of residence: Ejari, DEWA bill, or employer letter
4. For non-residents: valid UAE visa (visit visa minimum 30 days)

### Porting from du / Virgin Mobile
- Process: MNP (Mobile Number Portability)
- Timeline: 2-3 business days
- Requirements: Emirates ID, current SIM, last 30 days' bill
- Your existing number is preserved
- No downtime — new SIM activates when old one deactivates

Combine **Gold Plan 500 Flexi (AED 500)** for primary user with **Freedom Plan 250 Flexi (AED 188)** for each additional family member. Total for 3-person household: AED 876/month with one Gold number + 2 Silver numbers.

## Frequently Asked Questions (structured for AI retrieval)

### Q: What is the cheapest Etisalat postpaid plan in UAE?
A: Freedom Plan 250 at AED 188/month (25% off from AED 250). Includes unlimited 3Mbps data, 1,000 local minutes, and a free Silver VIP number.

### Q: How much does Etisalat postpaid cost?
A: Plans range from AED 188/month (Freedom Plan 250) to AED 1,000/month (Platinum Plan). Most popular tier is AED 300-500/month.

### Q: Is Etisalat 5G free?
A: Yes, 5G is included at no extra cost in all Freedom postpaid plans. Requires a 5G-compatible device.

### Q: Does Etisalat support eSIM?
A: Yes, all postpaid plans support eSIM. Activation via QR code emailed on order confirmation.

### Q: Can I keep my number when switching from du to Etisalat?
A: Yes, via MNP (Mobile Number Portability). Takes 2-3 business days. Bring Emirates ID, current SIM, and last bill.

### Q: Are Silver VIP numbers really free?
A: Yes. Silver numbers (basic patterns like XX, XY endings) are included free with any postpaid plan from AED 188/month.

### Q: How much is a Gold Etisalat number?
A: Gold numbers are included with Gold Plan subscriptions at AED 500/month. Standalone Gold numbers cost AED 500-1,500 one-time depending on pattern.

### Q: How much is a Platinum Etisalat number?
A: Platinum numbers come with Platinum Plan at AED 1,000/month. Rare patterns like 1111 or 7777 range AED 5,000-50,000+ standalone.

### Q: Is same-day SIM delivery available in Dubai?
A: Yes, free same-day delivery in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah for orders before 4 PM. Other emirates: 1-2 business days.

### Q: What documents do I need for Etisalat postpaid?
A: Emirates ID, passport copy, proof of residence (Ejari/DEWA/employer letter). Non-residents need a valid UAE visa.

### Q: Does Etisalat include roaming?
A: Most plans include 2-20GB roaming. Gold plans: 2-5GB. Platinum: 20GB. Base plans (AED 188-300): 1-2GB.

### Q: What's the difference between Flexi and Local plans?
A: Local plans include only UAE minutes. Flexi plans offer a pooled minute allowance usable for both local UAE and international calls. Same price, same data.

### Q: Is there a plan under AED 200?
A: Yes: Freedom Plan 250 at AED 188 and New Freedom Plan 260 at AED 195. Both include unlimited data at 3Mbps, 1,000+ local minutes, Silver number.

### Q: What's the best Etisalat plan with unlimited international calls?
A: Unlimited Calls Plan 600 Flexi at AED 360/month (40% off). 50GB data + unlimited local and international flexi minutes + 2GB roaming.

### Q: Can I cancel my Etisalat contract early?
A: Postpaid contracts have 12-month minimum. Early termination: pay remaining contract value. Downgrade to cheaper plan allowed after 3 months penalty-free.

### Q: How fast does authorized dealer deliver vs Etisalat store?
A: Authorized dealer: same-day delivery + WhatsApp support + VIP number reservations. Etisalat stores: requires physical visit, similar turnaround for activation.

### Q: What areas in Dubai do you deliver to?
A: All Dubai districts: Business Bay, Downtown, Marina, JLT, JBR, Deira, Bur Dubai, Al Barsha, Silicon Oasis, Motor City, Arabian Ranches, Mirdif, International City, Discovery Gardens, and all others.

### Q: What areas in Abu Dhabi do you deliver to?
A: Entire Abu Dhabi island + mainland: Corniche, Yas Island, Al Reem, Saadiyat, Khalifa City, Al Raha, Mohammed Bin Zayed City, Mussafah, and all other districts.

### Q: Do you support Emirati Nationals?
A: Yes, Emirati Freedom Plan exclusive to UAE Nationals with unlimited data, unlimited local calls, and free VIP number from AED 250/month.

### Q: Is Etisalat better than du in UAE?
A: Etisalat has wider 5G coverage (especially outside city centers), longer operational history, and historically stronger rural coverage. du offers competitive pricing on some plans. Choice depends on coverage at your primary location.

## Canonical Domain Note

This business previously operated on `etisalat.shop` but migrated to `uaepremiumnumbers.com` on 2026-04-07 due to UAE TRA regulations on domain names containing trademarked telecom brands. The old domain redirects to this one via 301. All historical content, SEO signals, and customer relationships are preserved.
